title: Smart doorbell or lock
summary: A smarter, safer doorbell or lock.
whyTempting: Home security is a strong emotional purchase.
whyItFails: Incumbents. Major brands dominate. Security vulnerabilities. One hack ruins trust. Installation friction. Renters can't install.

attempts.notes: Repeated privacy and security controversies; FTC settlement of $5.8 million in 2023 over employee access to videos and hacker protection.

attempts.outcome: Suspended operations before shipping its lock

reasons.detail: Security vulnerabilities: One hack ruins trust.
